verdict.rationale: The only documented sync path goes through the user's Google Account in Google's cloud. Nothing in the evidence describes a self-hostable sync server. Offline use without an account and manual QR-code transfer between devices keep secrets local, but they are adjacent workarounds rather than a sync server the admin runs. The PAM module verifies codes on a server and is not a sync server either.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter
